scenes.title: Dropout, quorum, and fresh rejoin
cues: The recorded T L S Flower recovery run accepted five, four, five, two, then five clients.
Recorded TLS Flower recovery: accepted contributors 5 → 4 → 5 → 2 → 5.
On attempt four, quorum three was missed, so version three stayed unchanged.
Attempt 4 missed quorum 3. The checkpoint remained at version 3.
Returning clients synchronized the current head. These were separate processes on one physical laptop.
Returning clients synchronized the current head. Separate processes on ONE physical laptop.

limitations: Five logical clients on one physical laptop.
The confirmed frozen-MPNet head is not LoRA; original LoRA evidence is preserved separately.
33 development runs use numerical federation and reused validation, not Flower runtime or new confirmation.
98.65% is selective accuracy at 74.33% coverage, not all-query accuracy.
The one-step client's 18-point inclusion benefit concerns four intents unique to that client.
61,520 bytes is the raw FP32 head per client per direction, not total wire traffic.
Physical multi-laptop recovery and fresh independent human queries remain pending.
